scope.transverseInterpretation: The seeds lie on the symmetry line and analytic Newton evolution preserves that symmetry in these runs. Zero computed transverse excursion is not an independent exclusion of off-line zeros or a proof that no untracked branch exists.

independentVerification.method: mpmath arbitrary-precision unshifted positive-real-axis theta quadrature; secant roots
independentVerification.scope: Checks the three real-line endpoint roots independently. Does not prove absence of other zeros or certify every trajectory segment. The same rapidly convergent theta representation is evaluated without contour shifting and in arbitrary precision; truncation is explicit.

formulas.derivativeBound: L = 16 integral_0^infinity u Phi(u) cosh(2ru) du

analyticContourEstimate.proofOfFormulas: Phi(u)>0 for u>=0 since each summand pi*n^2*exp(5u)*(2*pi*n^2*exp(4u)-3)*exp(-pi*n^2*exp(4u)) is positive. Bound cosh/sinh by cosh of the real part, apply |exp(tau*u^2)-1|<=exp(delta*u^2)-1, and apply the mean-value integral along the chord inside the disk. Formulas control every boundary point, unlike the raw sampled margin.
analyticContourEstimate.limitation: The inequalities are analytic. Their numeric integrals and boundary values here use high-precision floating-point quadrature, finite theta truncation, and no interval arithmetic. Positive nominal gaps are candidates for certification, not certified Rouche barriers or a proof of the initial zero count.
